description: Carga de Energia Verificada is a dataset listed in Brazilian national electricity system operator open data portal (ONS), an open data portal, published or maintained by ONS. Dados de carga verificada na periodicidade semi-horária por área de carga e suas componentes de parcela supervisionada pelo ONS, parcela proveniente dos dados de medição (geração tipo I, IIA, IIB, IIC e intercâmbios), parcela proveniente do sistema de medição para faturamento da CCEE (geração tipo III), parcela atendida por micro e mini geração distribuída (MMGD) ... Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher ONS. Its tags are Carga, DESSEM, Semi-horário. It offers 3 resource(s) in API, JSON, PDF. The portal shows 2025-10-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ons-portal.
